outputs.explanation: Panel A shows pseudocoloured confocal micrograph time-lapse images (photoactivation experiment), not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.

Panel B consists of line/scatter plots of normalized fluorescence intensity over time, with each experimental time point already plotted as an individual marker overlaid with a fitted decay curve. The insets show averaged early time-point responses with error bars, again presented as a scatter/line trace over time rather than as a bar chart of means. Since these are line/scatter-type plots (where overlaying additional individual points would be unreadable or where the points themselves already are the data), they are exempt from requiring separate individual data point overlays.
